title: Grateful Dead Live at Deer Creek Music Center on 1991-06-06
source: flac16/44 Source Info: TS Beyer CM 101-> Sony D6-> Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II's 90's). Transfer Info: Master Cassette-> Nakamichi CR-5A -> Grace Lunatec V3 (Analong-> Digital Converter) (SPDIF out) 24/48->Marantz PMD 661 MKII (Solid State Recorder)-> SD Card-> WAV-> FLAC Level 8-> Tagged (24/48). This is 24 bit -> 16 bit. Transfers by Pete Ebel

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch audience tape of a stellar ’91 show with an outstanding Jack Straw.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers hail this as the best audience recording of the date, noting its clarity and listenability compared to other muddy sources. The performance itself is praised as one of the strongest from 1991, with the rendition of "Jack Straw" singled out as a highlight. Overall the tape delivers both sonic fidelity and musical excitement.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both the recording (clear, best audience source) and the show (best of ’91 material), though only two brief reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced audience capture; reviewers note it is far less muddy than other tapes and the first listenable source for this date.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing, but overall the show is described as the best material from 1991.
